observation: Fresh main preserves the top-level browser validation plan for acceptance, but BrowserObservationOrgan.normalizeCheck still silently truncated distinct requiredSelectors beyond 48 and requiredText entries beyond 32. A required assertion after those cutoffs could therefore disappear before observation and incorrectly allow a browser check to pass.
changes: Keep the already-established 48-selector and 32-required-text limits, but fail closed when a normalized distinct plan exceeds them instead of truncating it.
Preserve existing URL validation, deduplication, boolean defaults, settle timing, CDP execution, and receipt semantics.
Add a regression proving overflow is rejected before any CDP/network observation is attempted.

verification.pre_fix_source_contract_replay: EXPECTED FAIL: normalizeCheck used Set(...).slice(0,48) and Set(...).slice(0,32), erasing overflow entries.
verification.post_fix_source_contract_replay: PASS: the same established limits are now explicit fail-closed gates with observed and limit metadata; domChecksScript's defensive 48-item bound remains unchanged.
verification.focused_regression_contract: tests/browser-inner-validation-budget-integrity.test.mjs exercises 49 distinct selectors and 33 distinct required-text assertions through BrowserObservationOrgan.observe with a non-responsive local CDP URL; both must reject during normalization, before transport.
verification.hosted_runtime: Developer Execution Runtime remained temporarily unavailable with HTTP 502; no hosted full-suite pass is claimed.

truth_boundary: This cycle does not invent new browser validation semantics or raise/lower existing limits. It only replaces silent loss of already-requested hard evidence with fail-closed enforcement at the existing observation boundary.
